CV.oracle_label: 解析基线上界参考：事后逐录像最佳CV，非可部署的新模型；ADE/FDE若取各自最低需分别标明
CV.source: recompute and verify Stage5.1 target IDs/history/future SHA and existing CV errors

aggregation: equal recording-person ID after within-person averaging
two-recording macro separately for each weighting
checkpoint_policy: immutable checkpoint whenever best K1 improves, at epoch1/every10/epoch100; metrics/target errors/parameter states every epoch; no old file overwritten
checkpoints: best improvements + periodic10 + last100; strict restore at1/every10 and selected best

diagnostics.capacity_definition: separate nominal, module-forward-used, graph-gradient-connected, observed-nonzero, structural scalar upper bound; no claim of equal effective capacity
diagnostics.epoch_gradient_tracking: per parameter scalar count with nonzero gradient, maxabs, ever_nonzero; structural dead masks audited

ego_capacity.caveat: similar scalar counts do not match function class; extra residual ego path changes inductive bias; empirical nonzero gradients audited separately
ego_capacity.initialization: unchanged torch.nn.Linear default, no zero-output branch
ego_capacity.placement: h_x + MLP(h_x) before original rnn_fy_init; posterior b unchanged

embargo: exact Stage5.1 train/dev support; no held-recording train and no promotion of old validation

evaluation.K20: independent ADE and FDE minima per target; first sample is candidate0
evaluation.every_epoch: full validation all metrics plus original supervised posterior objective; same per-target noise across epochs
evaluation.method: external evaluation-only Gaussian standard-noise provider through temporary distribution hooks; original loc/scale, forward, parameters and loss unchanged; remove hooks before training
evaluation.prior: original deterministic latent-prior-mean trajectory, not expectation over predicted trajectories

failure_policy: first nonfinite stops affected run, save model/optimizer/RNG/batch and traceback; no retry or hyperparameter search; independent other preregistered run still attempted

history_groups.support: only raw eight-frame positions and masks, never future error; keep all/empty groups

initialization: fresh seed17 per run; original base allocated first, then default PyTorch Linear MLP initialization; no checkpoint import; extra allocation consumes RNG, so later stochastic stream not promised identical to old architectures
loss: unchanged official mean reconstruction + Monte Carlo latent KL mean; not exact marginal NLL
model_selection: minimum validation target-window-weighted K1 latent-prior ADE; exact tie earlier epoch; FDE from same checkpoint

phase1_gate.capacity_sufficient: Ego ADE <= Full ADE and Ego FDE <= Full FDE*1.01 in both recordings and both weightings; stop without placebo
phase1_gate.continue_to_placebo: Full relative ADE gain (Ego-Full)/Ego >=1% and Full FDE <= Ego FDE*1.01 in both recordings and both weightings, plus capacity and isolation tests passed
phase1_gate.otherwise: conditional/conflicting/small differences: stop without placebo; no alternative seeds or architecture attempts
phase1_gate.primary: best K1 latent-prior ADE, paired FDE, exact same target cohort
phase1_gate.thresholds: preregistered development decision criteria, not statistical significance or formal noninferiority tests

phase2_authorization.pseudo_context: one deterministic target-history-only construction, frozen before any phase2 training; no real neighbor count/ID/position/velocity; no rule search

training_order: numpy default_rng(17+epoch).permutation(all train target indices), one complete pass, retain final partial batch
